facility.name: Kidzcare Learning Academy LLC
facility.programs_provided: Before School Care,Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Drop-In Care,Part Time Care,Transportation to/from School

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: Three children between the ages of 19 and 20 months were seen watching TV on an ipad.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §746.2207(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Medical Authorization: One out of four children's files was missing emergency medical information.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Physician Information (26 TAC §746.605(11))

occurrences.finding: Smoke-Detection System: The smoke detector is out of batteries and beeping.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Smoke-Detection System (26 TAC §746.5311(a))

occurrences.finding: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child: A teacher did not wash her hands after diapering an infant.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child (26 TAC §746.3415(4))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Bodies of Water Inaccessible to Children: A mop and bucket were found near the bathroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Bodies of Water Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3701(9))

occurrences.finding: Infant Handwashing - Raised to Sink: A caregiver did not wash a infant's hands after changing their diaper.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Handwashing - Raised to Sink (26 TAC §746.3421(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Children's Records: There were no records available at the time of inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Children's Records (26 TAC §746.801(1))

occurrences.finding: Diapering Procedures - Use Disposable Gloves: A teacher did not use gloves while wiping a child's nose.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diapering Procedures - Use Disposable Gloves (26 TAC §746.3505(c))

occurrences.finding: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Use Sanitary Holders: Snacks were served on the bare table.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Use Sanitary Holders (26 TAC §746.3317(6))

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing Before Eating: The children did not wash their hands prior to eating snack.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing Before Eating (26 TAC §746.3417(1))

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age: A three month old was combined with a two year old during naptime.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age (26 TAC §746.1605(1))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Using Inappropriate Long Period of Silence or Inactivity Including Requiring Child to Remain in a Restrictive Device: Children were seen in restrictive devices for approximately 35 minutes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Using Inappropriate Long Period of Silence or Inactivity Including Requiring Child to Remain in a Restrictive Device (26 TAC §746.2805(10))

occurrences.finding: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner: An open garbage was found in the hallways.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner (26 TAC §746.3407(8))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Children were seen running around the halls unsupervised. A caregiver left a group of seven chidlren alone.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean: The lights in one of the children's bathrooms is not working.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: Fence pickets were observed missing and broken accessible to children on the outdoor playarea during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Never Prop Bottles: A 6mo old infant was observed with a bottle of milk with a blanket used to prop it.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Never Prop Bottles (26 TAC §746.2419(3))

occurrences.finding: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device - Remove the infant from the device and place the infant in a crib as soon as possible: A 6mo old infant was observed to be sleeping in a baby swing
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device - Remove the infant from the device and place the infant in a crib as soon as possible (26 TAC §746.2426(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Employees' Attendance: The operation did not maintain records or time sheets listing all days and hours worked for each employee.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Employees' Attendance (26 TAC §746.801(5))

occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Annual Certification: The operation did not complete their annual children product certification for the year of 2024.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §746.4135(b))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Medication: The operation did not have a written policy when comes to procedures for dispensing medication or statement that medication is not dispensed to a child under their care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Medication (26 TAC §746.501(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Medication Authorization - Signed and Dated: One child file was review. The parent did not give written consent to daycare center staff to administrative medication to their under their care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Medication Authorization - Signed and Dated (26 TAC §746.3803(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Medication Records - Kept for 3 Months: The operation have not kept documentation of adminitative medication of dose of children under their care for the last three months.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Medication Records - Kept for 3 Months (26 TAC §746.3805(d))

occurrences.finding: Administering Medication - According to Label Directions: The operational staff is not following the label directions when adminsiative medication to a child giving it as needed to control the child behavior.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Administering Medication - According to Label Directions (26 TAC §746.3805(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Employees' Attendance: The operation did not maintain records or time sheets listing all days and hours worked for each employee.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Employees' Attendance (26 TAC §746.801(5))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Does not include Advertising or Violence: One child was observed playing on their tablet samsung a game called "sonic the hedgehog".
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Does not include Advertising or Violence (26 TAC §746.2207(c)(5))

occurrences.finding: Tracking System or Sign-in and Sign-out Logs: The operation do not a complete daily sign-in and sign-out log for licensing to review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Tracking System or Sign-in and Sign-out Logs (26 TAC §746.603(a)(8))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: Children under the age of two years were observed watching cartoons that not met educational goals.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §746.2207(a))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Does not include Advertising or Violence: One child was observed playing on their smart phone called "fortnite". It is online shooter game.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Does not include Advertising or Violence (26 TAC §746.2207(c)(5))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: One teacher was taking care of twenty-six children inside the classroom. The age ranged is 3 years old [16] , 4 years old [6], 5 years [3], 6 years old [1].
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Minimum Qualifications Child Care Center Employees and Caregivers - Affidavit: Five operational staff files were review. One out of the five operational staff files were missing the employment affidavit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Minimum Qualifications Employees and Caregivers - Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.1105(3))

occurrences.finding: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based: Five operational staff files were review. One out of five operational staff files were missing the First aid and CPR Certification.
occurrences.violation_type_title: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based (26 TAC §746.1315(b)(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records- Training Hours: Five operational staff files were review. One out of five operational staff files were missing the annual twenty-four hours of annual training for licensing to review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2912) (26 TAC §746.901(5))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: Ten children files were review. Three children files were missing the medical healthcare provider statement they are medically clear and good health to attend the childcare center care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR: Two operational staff has expired first aid and CPR certification since 06/01/2023.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1315(b))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required: Three operational staff has not complete their annual twenty-four clock hours to supervise children and for licensing to review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: Annual Sanitation Inspection: The operation has not completed the sanitation inspection at the time of the application inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3401(a))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - Activity Plans for each group of children in the child care center: The operation did not had required posting activity plan posted on each age appropriate classroom during the application inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - Activity Plans for each group of children in the child care center (26 TAC §746.401(5))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - List entitled "Current Employees"--sized at least 81/2 X 11 inches, printed legibly, include employee first and last name (26 TAC §746.401(9))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - List entitled: The operation did not had required posting for listed current employees available on the board for licensing to review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - List entitled "Current Employees"--sized at least 81/2 X 11 inches, printed legibly, include employee first and last name (26 TAC §746.401(9))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: Four classrooms were observed. All four classroom were not properly cleaned and sanitized.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: The operation has not completed the fire inspection at the time of the application inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Initial background checks submitted - At the time you submit your application: Two operational staff did not had their background checks submitted at the time of the application inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Initial background checks submitted - At the time you submit your application (26 TAC §745.621(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Director present-Minimum 75%: The interim director was not present during the application inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director present-Minimum 75% (26 TAC §746.1011(a))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age (26 TAC §746.1605(1))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - Daily menu, including all snacks and meals served by the child care center (26 TAC §746.401(6))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - Licensing Parent Notification Poster (26 TAC §746.401(7))
